role: Understanding the brain. Translating science. Sharing knowledge
intro: I am fascinated by the human brain and passionate about understanding it, translating scientific discoveries into meaningful clinical applications, and sharing neuroscience beyond academia.
second: As a neuroscientist, I focus on brain electrophysiology, computational modeling, and precision neuroscience. As an entrepreneur, I founded MINDIG to bridge research and clinical practice. As an author, I explore science communication through writing and storytelling, making neuroscience accessible to a broader audience.

topics.title: Brain Electrophysiology & Network Dynamics
topics.description: Understanding how large-scale brain networks emerge, interact, and reorganize over time using EEG and computational approaches.

topics.title: Individual Brain Variability & Normative Modeling
topics.description: Moving beyond group averages to characterize individual brain organization and variability, with a focus on normative modeling and personalized brain assessment.

topics.title: Precision Neurology & Psychiatry
topics.description: Translating quantitative brain measures into robust, reproducible, and clinically meaningful tools for understanding neurological and psychiatric conditions at the individual level.

trans_text: I founded MINDIG to connect computational neuroscience with real clinical and translational needs, particularly through high-density EEG and individualized brain analysis.
writing: Beyond the Lab — Books & Science Writing
book_text: مذكرات خلية عصبية is a science-inspired literary journey narrated through the voice of a neuron. The book opens the world of the brain to curious readers through storytelling.
contacttext: For research collaborations, scientific talks, and conversations about the brain and science writing.
